execution.method: raise ControlledExecutionFault before the candidate forward pass

numeric.method: apply the existing Section 6.5 perturb_output transform to candidate logits before loss
numeric.state_restored: model parameters are never modified by the perturbation

training.method: run a valid candidate forward but suppress backward and optimizer update
training.gradient_metrics: unavailable and serialized as null/empty CSV cells

couplings.teacher-forced: load the cloned PyTorch pre-step state before every candidate step
couplings.free-running: retain the candidate state produced by its preceding step
